originalFamilyScopeSummary: [Extension] Use a fresh Perps balance in MM Pay withdrawal confirmation
currentTriggerSummary: pr-complete: fix(perps): use a fresh Perps balance in MM Pay withdrawal confirmation
notes: Re-verified by live UI reproduction, not inference. With the pre-fix hook the real MM Pay Perps withdraw confirmation blocks a valid $378 withdrawal against a $756.39 balance: button reads 'Insufficient funds' and is disabled while the same screen displays 'Available balance: $756.39' (before-insufficient-funds.png, timeline shows insufficient=TRUE at 970ms with avail=$0.00 and still TRUE at 4266ms with avail=$756.39, clearing only at ~9s). With the fix the identical flow allows it: 'Withdraw' enabled, fee $0.72, receive $377.28 (after-withdraw-allowed.png), and insufficient is never true. Only the hook differs between runs. Scoped gates green on the merged tree: 36 tests across the three affected suites, verify-locales clean. The deferred display/Max parity item remains tracked as TAT-3661. Environment caveats recorded in learnings.md: Arbitrum is absent from the default fixture and had to be added at runtime, and EVM RPC only became usable after merging latest main plus a clean dev relaunch.
